answer: All P009–P020 exist. Audiveris raw ordinal 9–20 absence does not imply those physical bars are absent; its eight elements represent only the first bar of each system, separated by staff.
P001 upper G clef line 2; SmartScore omitted the entire upper opening system.
P001 lower G clef line 2. Audiveris raw 1 is upper P001 and raw 2 lower P001, both labelled staff 1.
No printed key signature; fifths 0 is appropriate, no explicit mode inferred.
No new meter in P002. Audiveris ordinal 2 is lower P001, where common time is printed.
P006 upper G2 is a system-start reprint, not a change.
Physical P003 lower onset 1/2 is G4 eighth. Audiveris ordinal 3 is upper P006, so the dissent is not a aligned-reader comparison.
Physical P003 onset 1 is upper F5 quarter plus lower D4 eighth. Neither MIDI60 nor E5 is the printed attack at this physical address. Audiveris ordinal 3 is upper P006.
Physical P008 onset 3/2 is upper G5 eighth plus lower C#4 eighth. The Audiveris lower C#4 claim belongs to P016, not P008. G4 is not an attack here.
Physical P008 onset 5/2 is upper C5 eighth with F5 continuing and lower D4 continuing. No new G4 attack. Audiveris ordinal 8 belongs to lower P016.
